**Nominal and Empirical Cis-pQTL Mapping**
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import torch
import tensorqtl
import os
import numpy as np
import qtl
import scipy
import scipy.stats as stats
from tensorqtl import pgen, cis, trans, post
import math
import rpy2
import rpy2.robjects as robjects
from rpy2.robjects.packages import importr

#enable GPU usage
os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "0,1"
os.environ["PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF"] = "max_split_size_mb:512"
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"torch: {torch.__version__} (CUDA {torch.version.cuda}), device: {device}")
print(f"pandas: {pd.__version__}")

#define paths to data
plink_prefix_path = "~/ancestry_specific_folder/ancestry_final"
expression_bed = "~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensor_lm_table.bed.gz"
prefix = "~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/nominal/qtl"
output_dir = "~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/nominal"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

#load phenotype data
phenotype_df, phenotype_pos_df = tensorqtl.read_phenotype_bed(expression_bed)

#PLINK reader for genotypes
pgr = pgen.PgenReader(plink_prefix_path)
genotype_df = pgr.load_genotypes()
variant_df = pgr.variant_df

#map
for chr_num in range(1, 24):
    chr_str = f"chr{chr_num}"
    print(chr_str)

    try:
        cis.map_nominal(genotype_df, variant_df, phenotype_df.loc[phenotype_pos_df["chr"]==chr_str],
        phenotype_pos_df.loc[phenotype_pos_df["chr"]==chr_str],
        prefix, covariates_df=None, maf_threshold=0)

        pairs_df = pd.read_parquet(f"{prefix}.cis_qtl_pairs.{chr_str}.parquet")
        print(pairs_df.head())

        pairs_df.to_csv(f"~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/nominal/nominal{chr_str}cis_qtls", sep="\t", index=False)

    except Exception as e:
      print(f"{e}")

    try:
        cis_df = cis.map_cis(genotype_df, variant_df,
        phenotype_df.loc[phenotype_pos_df["chr"]==chr_str],
        phenotype_pos_df.loc[phenotype_pos_df["chr"]==chr_str]
        , seed=123, nperm=10000)

        post.calculate_qvalues(cis_df, fdr=0.05, qvalue_lambda=0.85)

        cis_df.head()
        cis_df.to_csv(f"~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/empirical/empirical{chr_str}cis_qtls", sep="\t", index=True)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{e}")
```

**Trans-pQTL Mapping**
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import torch
import tensorqtl
import os
import numpy
import qtl
import scipy
from tensorqtl import pgen, cis, trans, post
import re

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"torch: {torch.__version__} (CUDA {torch.version.cuda}), device: {device}")
print(f"pandas: {pd.__version__}")

#define paths to data
plink_prefix_path = "~/ancestry_specific_folder/ancestry_final"
expression_bed = "~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensor_lm_table.bed.gz"
prefix = "~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/trans/qtl"

#load phenotypes
phenotype_df, phenotype_pos_df = tensorqtl.read_phenotype_bed(expression_bed)

pgr = pgen.PgenReader(plink_prefix_path)
genotype_df = pgr.load_genotypes()
variant_df = pgr.variant_df

try:
    #trans mapping
    trans_map = trans.map_trans(
        genotype_df,
        phenotype_df,
        batch_size=10000,
        return_sparse=True,
        pval_threshold=5e-5,  #threshold necessary due to memory limitations
        maf_threshold=0.01,
        return_r2=True
    )
    
    #filter cis-associations
    trans_filtered = trans.filter_cis(
        trans_map, 
        phenotype_pos_df, 
        variant_df, 
        window=1000000
    )
    
    #dummy covariate (just a constant)
    covariates_df = pd.DataFrame(1, index=genotype_df.columns, columns=['intercept'])

    #map permutations
    trans_map_perm = trans.map_permutations(
      genotype_df,
      covariates_df=covariates_df,
      maf_threshold=0.01, 
      batch_size=10000, 
      seed=123)
    
    trans.apply_permutations(trans_map_perm, trans_filtered)
    
    post.calculate_qvalues(trans_filtered, fdr=0.05, qvalue_lambda=0.85)
    
    trans_filtered.to_csv(f"/home/claudia/qtl_mapping/all_race/tensorqtl/trans/trans_perm.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)

except Exception as e:
    print(f'{e}')
```

**Filter and Format mapped pQTLS by FDR and Bonferroni-adjusted Pvalue:**
```{bash}
#combine empirical cis files
head -n 1 ~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/empirical/empiricalchr1cis_qtls > ~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/empirical/cis_qtls.tsv

for file in ~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/empirical/empiricalchr*; do tail -n +2 "$file" >> ~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/empirical/cis_qtls.tsv; done

#filter cis file
awk 'NR==1 || ($18 < 0.05) {print}' ~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/empirical/cis_qtls.tsv > ~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/empirical/0.05cis_qtls.tsv

#filter trans file
awk 'NR==1 || ($14 < 0.05) {print}' ~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/trans/trans_perm.tsv > ~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/trans/trans_fdr0.05.tsv 
```
